intro: Bake, mix, and level up in this cozy kitchen adventure inspired by grandma's recipe book!
description:
Inherit your grandma's beloved recipe book and rediscover all her favorite dishes - one delicious page at a time. Pick your favorite animal chef, from a curious rabbit to a cheerful bear, and step into a cozy kitchen full of charm.

Mix ingredients by hand, time your baking just right in the oven mini-game, and level up to unlock new recipes, ingredients, and upgrades. From pizza and bread to cakes and cinnamon rolls, every recipe adds another page to your own cooking story.

Features:
- Choose your favorite animal chef, each with their own personality
- Cook and bake a variety of recipes: pizza, bread, cake, and pastries
- Hands-on mixing and baking mini-games
- Level up to unlock new recipes, ingredient slots, and kitchen upgrades
- Relaxing solo gameplay
